_note: Prompts para generar los marcos de carta de la saga Poseidón (uno por tipo). No son cartas: loadFromJson no lo carga porque no tiene 'cards'. El centro se pide en magenta plano (#FF00FF) para recortarlo como transparencia y superponer el arte. La rareza se indica con la gema superior, que se cambia en una variante por rareza.
art_window: Zona interior para el arte: aprox. 84% del ancho y 58% del alto, centrada en la mitad superior
base_prompt: Empty Saint Seiya Poseidon-saga trading card frame template, front view, perfectly symmetrical, vertical 3:4. A refined 1980s Japanese anime-inspired game frame drawing on the mythological visual language of Saint Seiya: ancient Greek temple architecture, Marina Scale armor engravings, sea-dragon and sea-horse motifs, tridents, constellations, sculpted gold filigree, mother-of-pearl, coral and flowing ocean patterns. The large central art window and lower text box are completely filled with flat solid magenta (#FF00FF), with no gradients or texture inside either cutout. Small empty round gem socket at the top center, empty circular slots at top-left (cost) and top-right (generation). Preserve clean readable UI areas and crisp symmetrical edges. No text, letters, numbers, characters or watermark. High-resolution game UI asset.

frames.prompt: Knight frame inspired by the heroic Bronze Saints and Marine Generals of Saint Seiya's Poseidon arc: deep navy and royal ocean-blue enamel, polished antique-gold trim, sculpted Scale armor plates and subtle Pegasus, dragon and sea-creature engravings. Strong, noble, battle-ready silhouette.

Technique frame inspired by Saint Seiya's spectacular Cosmo attacks: bright turquoise and aquamarine enamel, luminous cyan energy channels, dynamic spiraling wave forms and subtle constellation-like star points. Energetic but keep the central art and text windows perfectly clear.

Occasion frame inspired by the dramatic events of Saint Seiya's Poseidon saga: sea-green and teal enamel, white sea-foam edges, curling wave crests and small mythological ocean ornaments. A sense of a sudden divine event, without cluttering the usable areas.

Object frame inspired by the sacred weapons and relics of Saint Seiya: antique treasure gold and brass, fine Greek meander engravings, pearl inlays, subtle barnacle and verdigris accents, elegant armory-like metalwork.

Stage frame inspired by the monumental underwater sanctuaries of Saint Seiya's Poseidon arc: abyssal midnight blue, deep violet and pale marble, carved Greek columns, pillar motifs and restrained bioluminescent details. Grand, architectural and symmetrical.

Helper frame inspired by the human companions and sacred attendants of Saint Seiya: soft sky-blue and pearl-white enamel, restrained coral-pink accents, delicate shells, small stars and gentle classical ornamentation. Warm and supportive rather than combat-focused.
